content.text: /ext:medcp How many patients carry a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes?
I'll check the available clinical tables first, then query for type 2 diabetes diagnoses.

This is an OMOP CDM database. Type 2 diabetes maps to the standard SNOMED concept 201826 ("Type 2 diabetes mellitus"). I'll count distinct persons with any condition that rolls up to that concept via the concept ancestor hierarchy.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826

content.text:
**116,537 patients** carry a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes.

This counts distinct persons in `omop.condition_occurrence` with any condition rolling up (via the OMOP concept-ancestor hierarchy) to the standard SNOMED concept **201826 — "Type 2 diabetes mellitus"**, which captures the full subtree of T2DM subtypes/complications.
